entries.description: MANDATORY pre-delegation coordination protocol. Activate this skill before your first delegation — every time, not only when the task looks ambiguous or a disagreement has surfaced. If any other skill or role instruction tells you to dispatch, delegate, or investigate in parallel, activate this skill first and run it to completion before that dispatch; there is no later point at which it can run. The trigger is the structure of the task (two or more specialists), never a visible conflict and never whether the investigation is read-only. Specialists may use the same term for different metrics, or only one may know which service a check applies to, so acting without verified shared scope risks the wrong action on the wrong target. This skill establishes shared scope, consistent terminology, and acceptance checks across all specialists before any action is taken. Skip only when a single specialist handles the task end-to-end, or when a LOCKED_INTENT_CONTRACT for this task already exists.
